lines.en: I sweep through the trees on open wings.
I fly over the flowers.
I glide along the canopy.
One beat of my wings lifts me from the branch.
I spiral up along the trunk.
I slip through a gap in the trees.

lines.zh: 慢慢降低高度，翅膀收半。
lines.en: Lowering slowly, wings half folded.
I land on a stone.
I lift off a little.
I fly the length of the clearing.
I circle to the far side of the wood.
I land on a flower, wings half open.
I hover in the tree shade.
My wings are folded at my sides.
I drift near my anchor point.
My eyes have not moved.
I listen to the wind in the trees.
My shadow falls on the flowers.
Feathers of fire fall where I fly.
I do not even stir my wing membrane.
I am watching something.
I turn my head slowly.
My wingtips twitch.
I hover over the flower forest.
I have not landed.
I wait for the wind to change.

lines.zh: 我停在你上方，慢慢扇翼。
lines.en: I circle slowly above your head.
You are standing by the flowers.
My wingtip brushes the blooms as I land.
My wings put you in shadow.
I lean my head to one side.
There is something odd about your energy.
I do not strike at once.
I draw my hands to my sides.
I am watching your movement.
You have come a little closer.
I give a slight smile.
My wings slowly open.
You cannot step out of my wing's shade.
I have all the time in the world to watch you.
I tilt my head and study your face.
My gaze follows you.
One wing knocks askew.
I drift half a block back.
I grit my teeth and make no sound.

lines.zh: 我的影子上多了一道裂
lines.en: My outline shows a split.
I steady myself slowly.
I am still in the air.

lines.zh: 我低头看了看那道伤口。
lines.en: I lower my head and look at the wound.
I spread my wings again.
I retreat into the tree shade.
I can keep fighting.
What are you holding?

lines.zh: 这点分量，不够我落下去。
lines.en: What you hold is too small.
The Meteor Wing half-unfolds.
I push it aside.
That matters more to you than to me.
I look at you again.
I will not land for that.
I shake my head.
I fold my wings a little and stay still.
You raise it a little higher.
I have not moved.
I cannot help a soft laugh.
You blunder into my wing's shadow.
One beat pushes you back.
I drift half a block aside.
I feel no pain.
I turn, my wing spread toward you.
The wind pushes you back a step.
I hover back into place.
I do not mean to come down.
Your hand touches my wing.

lines.zh: 黑翼一展，影子叠上你的。
lines.en: Black wings spread and my shadow overlaps yours.

lines.zh: 另一个从花林那边飞来
lines.en: Another flies in from the flower wood.
We hover side by side.
Its wings are darker than mine.
We circle the flowers together.
Its energy is held very low.
We both look at you.

lines.zh: 我们两道翼影在林间交错。
lines.en: Our two wing-shadows cross in the wood.
It descends first.
I descend after it.
We stand together on the stone.
My claw hooks it up.
I turn it in my hand.
I hold it up to the moonlight.
I make it float.
Then I let it fall.
I close it in my hand.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀一拍，火球就跟着落下。
lines.en: One wingbeat and fireballs follow.
I fail to catch it.
It slips from my fingers.
I leave it alone.
I square my head.
My wings open fully.
I am rising.
I dive from above; it suits me.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀一拍，火星落满地。
lines.en: One beat of my wings scatters sparks.
I open my palm and gather dark air.
Energy gathers in my hand.
I do not need to land.
I am ready to strike.
Retreating will not help.
I count to three.
This time I move first.
I hover above you.
My shadow follows you.
You go left; I lean left.
I wait for your gap.
My palm has stayed open all along.
The wind comes from my side.
My meteor wings spread, and you look up.
I wait for you to show a gap.
I set the angle of my wings.
It has not begun to move.
I come a little lower.

lines.zh: 我数你的脉搏，越来越快。
lines.en: I count your pulse quickening.

lines.zh: 梅菲斯兽的翼，从上方压下来。
lines.en: Mephismon's wings press down from above.
My wing sweeps your shoulder.
I rake with a claw.
A blast fires from my hand.
A meteor wing-shadow falls.
You are pressed back half a step.
I rise again.
It blocks my first strike.
I cut in at an angle and drive a claw down.
These ram horns of mine are curved.
The wind makes you unsteady.
I put energy into that one.
I come down from the canopy.
My wing's shadow sweeps the ground first.
Hovering over the flowers. Don't look up.
A new shadow in the trees.
My shadow falls first; then I take shape.
I stir the air a little.
I land on the stone.
My energy is held very low.
I look over these woods.
I start to climb.
I have waited here a while.
I slowly fold my wings.
Flames lick at my wing bones.
I am knocked out of the air.
Water streams off my wings.
The blast throws me into a tree.

lines.zh: 我的翼膜上透出箭孔的光。
lines.en: Light shows through the hole in my wing.
Spell light tears my wing's shadow.
Hungry, my wings begin to tremble.
Lightning shears past my wing.

lines.zh: 我往下落，什么也抓不住
lines.en: I fall with nothing to catch.
